Some woke up to this on October 7. Others still believe that cozying up to the world will eventually earn them likes and respect.

The page has been turned.
A new chapter has begun.

Either you understand, as a Jew, that you are different - not better - and that this difference is not about you, but about the God who chose to work in you, with you, and through you, or you risk finding yourself among the many who will perish.
